summary: UBS Commercial Mortgage Trust 2018-C13 filed an 8-K (Item 8.01, Other Events) to record the removal of Trimont LLC as special servicer of the Christiana Mall Mortgage Loan (4.2% of the asset pool) and the appointment of Green Loan Services LLC as successor special servicer under the BBCMS 2018-CHRS Trust and Servicing Agreement, effective July 14, 2026. This is a routine administrative servicing change without a new acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special situation. The filing contains no deal terms, financial consideration, or strategic event.
